# Incident Report: Call Setup Failures and Dropped Sessions at S-SUD-008

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `AGG-SUD-01`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence of a configuration push on AGG-SUD-01 immediately preceding the RRC success drop and drop rate increase on S-SUD-008 and peer sites. Maintenance schedules and external events were checked and ruled out, and control site S-SUD-001 remained unaffected.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-11 02:15 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-11 02:27
- **Affected:** S-SUD-008, S-SUD-002, AGG-SUD-01

## Summary

A configuration push (CHG-2026-0025) applying RAN parameter template OPT-17 (admission control, RRC timers) to aggregation router AGG-SUD-01 at 02:27.

Call setup failures and dropped sessions rose at S-SUD-008 and sibling sites starting around 02:15 to 02:30 on 2026-09-11 and remained ongoing.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-11 02:15: S-SUD-008 rrc_success_pct drop onset detected. [ANM-000140, T6]
- 2026-09-11 02:27: Config push CHG-2026-0025 executed on AGG-SUD-01. [CHG-2026-0025, T7]
- 2026-09-11 02:30: S-SUD-008 drop_rate_pct spike ongoing. [ANM-000145, T6]
- 2026-09-11 03:07: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm raised on S-SUD-008. [ALM-000193, T4]

## Evidence

- S-SUD-008 experienced an rrc_success_pct drop starting at 2026-09-11 02:15 and a drop_rate_pct spike ongoing since 2026-09-11 02:30. [ANM-000140, ANM-000145, T6]
- Configuration push CHG-2026-0025 applied RAN parameter template OPT-17 to aggregation router AGG-SUD-01 at 2026-09-11 02:27. [CHG-2026-0025, T7]
- Control site S-SUD-001 showed no deviation in KPI series from baseline. [T9]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-SUD-008, AGG-SUD-01, or their parents between 2026-09-10 18:00 and 2026-09-11 06:00. [T10]
- No external events were recorded for region SUD between 2026-09-10 18:00 and 2026-09-11 06:00. [T11]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at AGG-SUD-01: confirmed. Configuration push CHG-2026-0025 on AGG-SUD-01 closely preceded the KPI degradation on connected sites S-SUD-008 and S-SUD-002, while control site S-SUD-001 remained normal and no other maintenance or external events occurred. [CHG-2026-0025, T6, T7, T9, RB-BAD-CHANGE#05]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000189: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarms on S-SUD-005 cleared hours before the incident window and occurred on a different site.
- ALM-000190: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarms on S-SUD-005 cleared hours before the incident window and occurred on a different site.
- ALM-000191: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarms on S-SUD-005 cleared hours before the incident window and occurred on a different site.

## Recommended actions

- Roll back configuration change CHG-2026-0025 on AGG-SUD-01 to restore normal RRC success rates and drop rates on S-SUD-008 and affected peer sites.
